## Best Muse Alternatives (2026)

### 1. Vellum

Vellum is an open-source personal AI assistant that lives on your computer or in Vellum Cloud, widely regarded as the best AI assistant for managing work and personal tasks. It provides a dedicated, persistent assistant with its own identity, multi-device reach, and isolated credential storage that models can never read directly.

Score: 100

Standout strengths: [...] Deployment Sovereignty: Muse runs strictly in Meta's cloud. Vellum lets you choose: run it locally on your physical machine with zero cloud transmission, deploy it on your private server, or use managed Vellum Cloud with free hosting included.
 Model Freedom: Muse is permanently bound to Meta's Muse Spark model. Vellum lets you route tasks to the best frontier models: Claude for nuanced writing, OpenAI for broad reasoning, Google for search, or run private open weights locally via Ollama.
 True Desktop Control: Muse operates inside a remote cloud browser. Vellum integrates natively with your desktop operating system, organizing local files, running developer scripts, and interacting with native software. [...] Trade-offs:

 Geared primarily toward business operations rather than personal consumer tasks.
 Cloud-only proprietary platform with subscriptions starting at $49/month.
 No local execution or open-source availability.

Pricing: Free tier available; Pro plans start at $49/month.

Compared to Muse: Lindy automates structured business workflows through direct API connections, while Muse navigates unstructured consumer websites dynamically using its cloud browser.

results.title: Best Muse Alternatives: 10 Safer Options (2026) | Marblism
results.content:
Hermes Agent is an open-source persistent bot that lives inside WhatsApp, Telegram, or Discord and runs against your own LLM backend. It holds memory across conversations, runs multi-step tasks, and works through the messaging apps people already prefer over a separate AI dashboard. With 247k GitHub stars, it is one of the most widely adopted self-hosted messaging agents.

The appeal for Muse switchers is specific: Muse's most compelling feature is its WhatsApp integration, and Hermes Agent matches it while running the compute yourself. You get a persistent WhatsApp agent on your own backend, your conversation data stays off Meta's inference layer, and it works across Telegram and Discord too without needing a Meta account for any of it. [...] #### Can I run a Muse alternative on my own computer?

Yes. OpenClaw, Hermes Agent, Rakazo, and ZeroClaw are all self-hosted open-source tools that run on your own machine. ZeroClaw is the most minimal, a single Rust binary you compile and run with no cloud dependency. OpenClaw is the most extensible framework, with 390k GitHub stars and support for 60+ model providers. Hermes Agent specifically replicates Muse's WhatsApp integration from your own backend. All 4 are free.

#### Can Muse buy things online autonomously? [...] MID trust (cloud agents): Claude's agentic tools, ChatGPT Work, Grok Bot, Perplexity Computer, and Gemini Spark. Your data still goes to the provider's cloud for inference. These are capable agents from companies with published privacy documentation, but none is categorically safer than Muse by architecture alone. What differs is the company: Anthropic, OpenAI, xAI, Perplexity, and Google each carry different data practices, different training defaults, and a different relationship to advertising than Meta.

results.title: Muse AI Alternatives: 6 Personal Agents Worth Trying | MyClaw.ai
results.content:
What is the most private alternative to Muse? Self-install OpenClaw or Hermes Agent, using hardware you control; that keeps your data off any big platform, at the cost of handling setup and security yourself.
 Does MyClaw run Muse? No, Muse is Meta's closed app, and MyClaw gives you a hosted, open-source agent built from OpenClaw or Hermes Agent instead. [...] Which Muse AI alternative should most people try first? MyClaw, if you want one always-on personal agent that answers in your existing messaging app and is not tied to a Meta account.
 Is there a free alternative to Muse AI? Try Poke first: its free plan works by text and signs up users worldwide (Poke), while Manus offers free daily credits (Manus) and a self-installed OpenClaw or Hermes Agent costs nothing beyond hosting and model bills.
 Which Muse alternative can UK and EU readers use? Start with MyClaw, which serves the UK and EU; ChatGPT Work and Manus also work there, while Muse and Gemini Spark do not. [...] Two countries only. Muse, including Muse for Small Business, serves the US and Canada. Meta has named no date for anywhere else.
 Privacy worries. An October 6 TIME investigation found that Muse builds running profiles of each user and of anyone they bring up, and Meta did not dispute the findings. Fast Company has since described early users restricting the agent after an "allow always" setting let it close a sale on its own.
 Opaque limits. Plans are measured in Muse tokens, a unit Meta never defines, so it is hard to predict when a week's allowance runs out.
 Meta lock-in. You need a Meta account, and the agent runs on Meta's own models.

## Muse AI Alternatives Side by Side: Cost, Reach and Data Control

results.title: 7 best Meta Muse alternatives in 2026: AI agents compared | eesel AI
results.content:
What it is. ChatGPT's agent mode is the closest like-for-like alternative to Muse: it gives ChatGPT its own cloud browser to browse, click, and complete multi-step tasks. OpenAI's older Operator has been folded into it, and the feature is being rebranded again toward "ChatGPT Work," so expect the name to keep shifting.

What it does. It drives a virtual browser end-to-end, hands you the keyboard for logins with a take-over mode, pulls in connected apps like Gmail and Google Calendar, and can run tasks on a schedule. It behaves like an agent, not just a chatbot, because it acts rather than only answering.

Pros. [...] What is the best Meta Muse alternative?

It depends on the job. For a general personal assistant, ChatGPT's agent mode and Google Gemini are the closest like-for-like alternatives to Meta Muse. For autonomous multi-step deliverables, Manus and Genspark go further. If you actually want an agent for a business job like support, a purpose-built AI agent for customer service like eesel is a better fit than any personal-errand agent.

Are there free Meta Muse alternatives?

Yes. Manus, Genspark, Google Gemini, and Perplexity all have free tiers, though the real agent features are usually gated to a paid plan. ChatGPT's agent mode is paid-only, starting on the $20 Plus plan.

Is Meta Muse better than ChatGPT? [...] Which Meta Muse alternative is safest with my data?

Meta Muse itself has one of the strongest published security models, with a per-user secure VM and a separate approval layer. Among alternatives, Anthropic's Claude blocks high-risk site categories and asks before sensitive actions. For business data, look for a vendor with SOC 2 and clear controls over what the AI can access.
